review_type: independent AI editorial review of eight new A2 writing items
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (fresh context, separate from the author)

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings were written to content/reviews/107-review.md from the source-only packet (original hash e174684ff999546ee9bc18d11666469fab8077b8e45dd8244acc18cc72197118) before criteria, samples, starters or notes were opened. The packet was rebuilt from the proposed bytes after edits to four items; the changed items were re-read and passed.

tone_balance.scope_note: 8 ordinary tasks, no lightly funny item; the plan puts no humour in writing. The coordinator checks the combined A2 count.

edits.before: U schrijft haar een e-mail. Schrijf de e-mail.
edits.after: U schrijft haar een e-mail en vraagt of zij u wil helpen. Schrijf de e-mail.
edits.reason: The e-mail's purpose was only in the subject line; the prompt now states it.

edits.before: Vraag of Nuria donderdagavond na zeven uur bij u thuis kan komen.
edits.after: Vraag of Nuria u wil helpen. Stel zelf een dag en een tijd voor.
edits.reason: The prompt never named Thursday evening after seven, so a learner who followed the prompt could not meet the criterion.

edits.before: over een nieuwe pas voor het afval
edits.after: over nieuwe regels voor het afval
edits.reason: 'Pas voor het afval' is an odd phrase for an A2 learner; 'nieuwe regels' is plain and the model stays at 45 words.

edits.before: Hiervoor vraagt u de gemeente om een ja.
edits.after: Hiervoor vraagt u de gemeente of het mag.
edits.reason: 'Om een ja vragen' is not natural Dutch for asking permission.

edits.before: Tot hoe laat is er muziek en wat doet u voor de rust?
edits.after: Tot hoe laat is er muziek en wat doet u als de muziek te hard is?
edits.reason: 'Voor de rust' is abstract; the concrete question is clear at A2. Criterion 3 and the model follow: 'Als de muziek te hard is, zet ik hem zachter.'

edits.field: images.0.brief, images.1 (brief, alt), criteria, sample, quotes, model
edits.before: Bike leaning on a fence with a lock and a key on a hook; criteria lock the bike, put it in the shed, air in the tyres
edits.after: Picture 1 shows one soft tyre with a pump and a black bike; picture 2 shows the black bike locked to a lamp post in the street; criterion 3 accepts that the bike is in the shed or must be put there; 'band' not 'banden'; the hung key was dropped
edits.reason: The old pictures placed the bike in two places and left 'lock' versus 'unlock' and 'take out of' versus 'put into the shed' open; a lock key hung beside the lock is not believable. Sample and model follow the new wording; quotes are verbatim.

edits.before: Schrijf ook wanneer u thuis bent. Schrijf in hele zinnen.
edits.after: Schrijf ook wanneer u thuis bent. Bedank de persoon voor de hulp. Schrijf in hele zinnen.
edits.reason: Picture-note criteria are hidden, so the thank-you criterion was not asked by the prompt.

edits.before: Schrijf dat het deurtje van de brievenbus los hangt.
edits.after: Schrijf wat er mis is met de brievenbus, bijvoorbeeld dat het deurtje los hangt.
edits.reason: A learner who writes that the letterbox is broken has done what the prompt asked.
The old starter forced 'mij' although the learner registers two people.

edits.before: De muziek is tot ... en wij ...

batch_check.result: Checked 8 items, no failures; 3 compound warnings (busbedrijf, maandkaart, wijkkrant) judged transparent at A2.

checks.word_gate: No unlisted word in strict fields. Listed words that were checked in context: patient, paspoort, openingstijden, afval, regels, halte, schuurtje, slot, plafond, lekt, deurtje are plain for A2. 'Vergunning' and 'toestemming' were avoided; 'of het mag' used instead. Compounds busbedrijf, maandkaart, wijkkrant: transparent.
checks.names: Huisartsenpraktijk Wilgenhof and Busbedrijf Hazelaar were searched by the author on 22 Nov 2026 (no match found); not re-searched. Nuria and Emre appear once each; Ioana appears once in a model.
checks.dates: 4 January 2027 is a Monday; 15 May 2027 is a Saturday.
checks.open_task_contract: Models are 27-48 words (checker 20-90; fiets-lenen is a picture note of three one-sentence instructions); every sample has one null quote and verbatim quotes; criteria now fit the prompts.

diversity.within_batch: Two e-mails (GP, friend with letter), two forms (bus pass, street party), two wijkkrant texts (street, family), two picture notes (bike, flat repairs).
diversity.set_assembly: Keep straatfeest-aanvragen away from batch092-buurman-feest, and fiets-lenen and huismeester-briefje away from batch092-buurman-vakantie in the same set (all are note or party tasks of a similar shape).

media_notes.pictures: Six pictures for fiets-lenen (bike) and huismeester-briefje (flat); no people, so no cast traits. Draw all three fiets-lenen panels with the same plain black bicycle. Picture 3 of fiets-lenen shows only the bike in the open shed. Alts list pictured facts, acceptable for open tasks.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Organisation names were not re-searched; the author's web search is relied on.
Pictures were judged as briefs, not as rendered images.

evidence.criteria_vs_prompt: Prompt gives the move, the six-year-old and the practice; criteria ask registration for whom (answered by the prompt facts), a document or card to bring, days and times, and one more question, each producible by a learner who follows the prompt with the invented parts marked Bedenk zelf.
evidence.sample: Omits the extra question (null quote 4); errors 'ons inschrijven ... voor mij en mijn dochter' and 'woensdag middag'.
evidence.starters: Starter 1 changed to 'Ik wil ... inschrijven voor ...' so it fits the reflexive choice (mij/ons) the original 'Ik wil mij ... voor ...' forced wrongly for two people; the other three are partial and name no document, time or question.

meaning.situation_summary: A newly arrived parent writes to a GP practice to register herself and her six-year-old and asks what to bring and when they can come.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Get both people registered with a huisarts and learn what papers are needed.
meaning.contrivance_check: Moving house is the stated reason for needing a new GP; the practice name was searched (no practice Wilgenhof) and the child is given in the prompt, so nothing off-page is needed.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A formal first contact with an unknown practice: e-mail to the general address, Geachte heer/mevrouw and u fit; the questions are ordinary for registration.

evidence.criteria_vs_prompt: The prompt now says the learner asks Nuria to help; the original criterion demanded 'donderdagavond na zeven uur', a time the prompt never gave. meaning.situation_summary: A learner has a municipal letter they cannot follow and asks a friend who speaks good Dutch to come and help in the evening.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Get help reading and understanding an official letter, and arrange when and where.
meaning.contrivance_check: The friend's language skill is stated in the prompt; the letter topic is invented by the learner; no off-page event is needed. Model changed from 'een nieuwe pas voor het afval' to 'nieuwe regels voor het afval' for plainer words.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: An informal e-mail to a friend about a private problem; Hoi / je / Groetjes fit, and a letter that must be understood is a reason to ask someone in person.

evidence.criteria_vs_prompt: The original sequence mixed two bike places (fence with lock, key on a hook, and a shed) and could be read as 'unlock' or 'take the bike out'. Picture 2 now shows one bike locked to a lamp post in the street, so 'op slot doen' is the only sensible instruction; picture 1 shows one soft tyre (criterion now 'band', not 'banden'); criterion 3 accepts that the bike is in the shed or must be put there. The unbelievable lock key on a fence hook was dropped from sample and model.

meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Informal note on the table for a friend: Hoi Emre, imperatives or wil je, Groetjes fit.
